Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?
Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.
Role Overview:
The PlayStation Network Advertising team is a sophisticated, global advertising sales organisation focused on servicing strategic platform partners. As a leader in gaming and entertainment we are continuously diversifying our business models to align our service with the needs of our customers. In the last couple of years, we have accelerated rapidly beyond our anticipated growth trajectory and we are seeking an experienced, service oriented, sales and marketing professional to build long-term advertising partnerships with PlayStation’s key Partners.
The Client Partner will act as a consultant, demonstrating leadership and providing business insight with a focus on driving revenue growth, strategic account development and selling PlayStation’s suite of advertising solutions to our most integrated business partners. You’ll be an integral part of the Network Advertising team working closely with a number of internal stakeholders to develop these partnerships, creating new marketing opportunities and executing on a number of PlayStation’s strategic initiatives. Success in this position requires a passion for entertainment, strong consultative sales and analytical skills, ability to identify and develop footholds across media agencies, a focus on exceptional client service, and the ability to thrive in and contribute to a dynamic, team-focused environment.
What you'll be doing:
Help define PlayStation’s overall approach within a designated segment of our addressable market, including on a specific set of key client responsibilities
Seek to understand customer needs, challenges and strategic priorities by cultivating lasting relationships with client stakeholders at all levels
Drive strategic conversations by defining objectives and providing recommendations on how to best leverage the PlayStation platform
Deliver holistic success of your accounts measured by revenue growth/profitability, new product and solutions uptake, and customer satisfaction
Manage and update revenue tracking documentation, pipeline and opportunities, and report revenue forecast predictions to internal stakeholders
Work with cross functional client facing teams to build business cases which support advertising revenue growth to take to rev ops and product teams as improvement ideas
Operate as the primary point of contact for any and all matters specific to your clients, including escalations
Represent PlayStation by acting fairly, with integrity and with the highest ethical standards in external partner meetings
What we're looking for:
Proven years of working experience in gaming or entertainment, digital media, marketing or advertising industries
Strong understanding of PlayStation, our ecosystem, and its core players
Proven track record of delivering multi-channel advertising campaigns with familiarity of advertising best practices, trends, terms & conditions
Demonstrated ability of achieving profitable revenue growth
Experience working in and navigating a large or high-growth organisation with many cross functional stakeholders
Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to structure, negotiate, and maintain significant and complex strategic relationships
A true team player that nurtures and develops team members and cross functional partners
Ability to travel as required

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Kafka Developer builds and operates the event streaming that connects Team Caliber — the NBA platform's business rules engine, built in Java and Drools — to the rest of the decisioning system. You design and own the Kafka topics, producers, and consumers that move eligibility, suppression, and decisioning events through the platform reliably and in order. This is a hands-on backend role for an engineer who is fluent in event-driven design and enjoys making high-throughput, fault-tolerant streaming systems work correctly under real production load. Key Responsibilities • Event streaming — Design, build, and own Kafka producers, consumers, and topic strategy that carry rules-engine inputs and outputs across the platform. • Rules engine integration — Integrate the Java/Drools rules engine with upstream and downstream systems through well-designed event and API contracts. • Reliability — Engineer for correctness under load: partitioning, ordering, idempotency, exactly-once or effectively-once semantics, retries, and dead-letter handling. • Backend services — Build and maintain the Java services around the rules engine that produce and consume events and expose APIs. • Performance and scale — Profile and tune streaming throughput and latency; ensure the pipeline scales as event volume grows. • Observability — Instrument streams and services with logging, metrics, and alerting so issues are caught early and diagnosed quickly. • Quality — Write tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards; the platform handles member PHI, so security and compliance hygiene are essential. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with the Drools rules engine or another business rules management system. • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, schema registry, and Avro/Protobuf. • Experience with stream processing patterns and real-time data pipelines. • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling requirements.
